title: terrain.wall_bulging
description: M14F L1 wall-bulging warning. Emitted when a chunk's lateral integrity_field drops below the L1 locked threshold (200) for at least one cell on the lateral axis. Drives the L1 sidewall crack decal + 'MINESHAFT WALL UNSTABLE' HUD banner.

chunk_id.description: Lateral-wall chunk coordinate as [cx, cy] in chunk-space.

bbox.description: Pixel-space AABB of the bulging lateral wall region.

unsupported_span_px.description: Unsupported lateral span (in pixels) that drove the integrity decay.

min_integrity.description: Minimum cell integrity observed in the chunk this pass (0..=255).

lateral_yield_strength.description: Per-material lateral yield strength (concrete=50, brick=30, steel=200, wood=15, dirt=10).

vibration_modifier.description: Vibration modifier driving the bulging probability (1.0 baseline).

level.description: Crack-decal level rendered by this event. Bulging emits 'l1'.
